title: Related Task Attachment
description: Support adding other tasks as a first class attachment type. Use drop-down that supports auto complete text search

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Verified the related-task attachment flow end to end in a sandboxed Tasks UI instance with copied task data. The Attachments tab exposes autocomplete search, selecting TSK-0173 enables the add action, the related-task attachment persists to disk as a `task:` attachment, and the rendered attachment button navigates to the related task detail. Marking done based on working behavior already present in the current codebase.
